articles.summary: Company announced updated 2030 financial targets of revenue of more than $7.5 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $1.6 billion, reflecting accelerated growth across its expanded platform Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power generation and energy storage solutions, today updated its 2030 financial outlook at its Capital Markets Day, reflecting the expansion of its product portfolio and accelerated execution of its strategy. Nextpower is now targeting more than $7.5 billion in revenue, more than $1.6 billion in adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of more than $8.00 by FY30. The updated FY30 revenue target is approximately 45% higher than the $5.2 billion target presented at last year’s Capital Markets Day (November 2025). The increase reflects the expansion of Nextpower’s platform and growth opportunities across its existing markets. Power collection and conversion and energy storage are each expected to become billion-dollar businesses by FY30.
